stops.note: shining stone, from marmairein (to shine, sparkle)
carried into Latin for the polished, crystalline rock
carried into French for the same prized building stone
settled as the English word for the crystalline metamorphic rock
stops.meaning: a crystalline metamorphic rock used in sculpture and building

current_meaning: a hard crystalline rock, prized for sculpture and building, formed from recrystallized limestone
